name: Volatility-expansion trend follow (5m)
rationale: The mirror of the low-vol momentum thesis: on 5m, a HIGH realized volatility together with a strong ADX says a violent, directional regime is live — the moment to ride the trend rather than fade it. The other side is the reversion scalper who keeps fading spikes in a regime that is trending hard. Edge persists because high-vol trending bursts (news-driven, liquidation-driven) have strong short-horizon continuation before they exhaust. Distinct from the ATR-expansion breakout: the confirmation is trend STRENGTH (ADX), and the regime filter is realized vol, not the ATR level itself. Disconfirmer: exits when ADX collapses under the exit floor (trend died) or the stop fires.
